name: Lemon drizzle cake
origin: A British loaf cake finished, while still warm, with a syrup of lemon juice and sugar poured over the top, which soaks in and sets into a faintly crunchy, tart crust as it cools.

ingredients.note: lemon juice mixed directly into the batter itself, distinct from the post-bake lemon-sugar drizzle

process.name: cream butter and sugar
process.description: beat butter and sugar until light

process.name: add eggs, zest and juice
process.description: beat in eggs, lemon zest and lemon juice

process.name: fold in flour
process.description: fold in flour, leavening and salt

process.name: bake and drizzle
process.description: bake in a loaf pan, then, while still warm, pour over a lemon-juice-and-sugar syrup so it soaks into the crust

notes: A standard equal-weights British loaf cake (see victoria-sponge.json, madeira-cake.json) with lemon juice and zest mixed directly into the batter. The finishing lemon-sugar drizzle poured over the warm baked loaf is a separately-prepared syrup soaked into an already-set crumb, a different physical process (diffusion into a porous solid, as in tres-leches.json) and is kept out of the ingredient list, per catalog.ts's scope note.
